p4_b4.ocr: We also ranked exposure of all HUC12s by UOG activities by calculating total exposure only defined by UOG well density and well proximity to flowlines. UOG-only exposure scores were then multiplied by companion sensitivity scores to generate UOG-only vulnerability ranks. UOG-only exposure scores were consistently high due to density of UOG wells in catch- ments where activity was present and from differences in well proximity to flowlines (Fig 6). UOG-specific vulnerability varied more within plays due to differences in HUC12 sensitivity to disturbances (Fig 7). All HUC12 environmental values are provided in S3 Table. Bakken Vertical well densities were lower in the Bakken than the across-play average (mean = 0.02 ver- sus 0.14 wells km-2, respectively), but non-vertical (0.07 wells km-2) densities were greater than the across-play average (0.06 wells km-2). Despite the intensity of oil and gas development over the last 5 years, wells tended to be set farther back from NHD flowlines (mean 718.6 m for unconventional and 797.4 m for vertical) and spaced farther apart than in other plays.
